subtitle.en: ACT International Subject Test — Mathematics 2. Builds on ACT 2 Math Level 1 with complex numbers, matrices and vectors, advanced functions, limits, and polar/trigonometric precalculus — proof-first, matching the site's Rigor Standard.

introText.en: Take ACT 2 Math Level 2 material offline. The PDF prints from your browser; the Word packet contains editable OMML equations for classroom customisation.
